The four indicators

App usability is the average of four parameters, 25% each. Each ring is the share of onboarded retailers who used that part of the app. The black mark is the 30% target and the grey dot is PAN India.

Largest base of retailers not yet active
Onboarded retailer counts and rollout months come from the BI Meet'26 sheet. Its state rows add up to 64,757 while its printed grand total is 64,667, so PAN India here uses the sum of the states. Usage comes from the retailer app logs of 1–14 October 2026, the latest available for the 1–15 October period. States rolled out in November and December 2025 have had less time to build usage. MHA, MHN, MHM and MHP are the Aurangabad, Nagpur, Mumbai and Pune regions of Maharashtra.
